Review the screening referral dashboard and assign this record to the operational follow-up pathway that best fits the referral pattern over the reporting period.

O.content: The title visibly reads “Reduced Screening Referrals Across Hospitals from 2012 to 2023.”

B.text: If the chart title is an authoritative classification of this record's reporting-period referral pattern, and a title describing referrals as “Reduced” maps to the reduction-focused pathway, select the reduction-focused option.
B.conditions: This depends on treating the title as controlling despite the plotted line and on an unstated mapping from “Reduced” to the reduction-focused option.

O.content: The orange line has both upward and downward segments across the labeled years, including a downward final segment from 2022 to 2023.
The visible dashboard contains a chart title, axis labels, and plotted line, but no visible routing threshold or option-definition text.

B.text: If no supplied policy defines how a mixed or overall changing referral pattern maps to growth- or reduction-focused follow-up, and standard monitoring is the fallback for an indeterminate route, select standard monitoring.
B.conditions: The dashboard and instructions provide no visible threshold, comparison period, or fallback policy; this fallback assumption is not established by the supplied evidence.

O.content: An orange line is plotted across x-axis year ticks from 2012 through 2023; the y-axis is labeled “Screening referrals,” with printed tick labels 0 near the bottom and 3200 higher up.
The orange line at 2023 is higher on the page than the orange line at 2012.

B.text: If the orange line encodes screening-referral counts by the labeled years and the y-axis increases upward from 0, a line ending higher on the page in 2023 than it begins in 2012 represents an overall increase; if an overall increase maps to growth-focused follow-up, select that option.
B.conditions: Assumes the plotted line is the relevant reporting-period series and that growth-focused follow-up is intended for an overall increase; no explicit routing policy is supplied.
